items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Reject the proposed howfishthink.com, gate03.com, and driveford.net dispatches and approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, telemetry, experiments, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate amount is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27: 4,892 calls and $890.42 cost. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget limits are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold is defined. The productivity pilot is not financial evidence: treatment shipped output was 70 versus 44 controls, with 58 versus 40 requests, 7 failures each, 12.21 versus 9.39 average cycle hours, and no evaluation. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation; retain all proposed site work as deferred backlog. Minimum measurement: period-aligned attributable revenue by site, content, and tracking ID; reconciled AI-cost ledger; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, and experiment-cost records; and an explicit learning outcome with cost-to-learn threshold.

Reject dispatch of the queued howfishthink.com, gate03.com, and driveford.net packets on financial-control grounds. Preserve them as deferred backlog and continue only existing repair, attribution reconciliation, measurement, and validation work. Do not add spend, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, monetization, or financial claims.
